scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build:verify
scripts.build:verify: node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; const w = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '../dist'); for (const f of ['index.html','panel.js']) { if (!existsSync(path.join(w,f))) throw new Error('missing web/dist/'+f); } const js = readFileSync(path.join(w,'panel.js'),'utf8'); if (/^\s*import\s|from\s*['\"][.\/]/m.test(js)) throw new Error('panel.js is not self-contained (external import found)');"
